description: This Java source file defines an Android application class named RssReader that demonstrates an RSS feed reader. It includes functionality for downloading RSS feeds in a background thread, parsing RSS XML data, displaying items in a custom ListView adapter, and handling user interactions such as clicking on items to open links in a browser. The class also maintains application state across configuration changes, supports menu options for different RSS feeds, and contains nested classes for adapter, background worker, and menu handling.

classes.name: RSSListAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter subclass for displaying RssItem objects in a ListView, providing getView() implementation to render each item with a title and a snippet of description.

classes.name: RSSWorker
classes.description: Background thread class that downloads RSS feed data from a given URL, parses it, and posts RssItem objects to the UI thread.

classes.name: RssMenu
classes.description: Inner class implementing menu item click listener to set the RSS URL in the input field.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, adapter, and event handlers.

methods.name: removeTags
methods.description: Utility method to strip HTML tags from a string for display purposes.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on an RSS item, launching an intent to view the link.

methods.name: resetUI
methods.description: Clears the current list of RSS items and resets status text.

methods.name: setCurrentWorker
methods.description: Assigns a new RSSWorker instance as the current background thread, interrupting any previous one.

methods.name: isCurrentWorker
methods.description: Checks if the provided worker instance is the currently active one.

methods.name: doRSS
methods.description: Starts a new background thread to download and parse an RSS feed from the specified URL.

methods.name: parseRSS
methods.description: Parses the RSS XML data from an InputStream using XmlPullParser, extracting items and posting them to UI asynchronously.
